source.text: וַיְהִי֙ אַחֲרֵי־כֵ֔ן וַיָּ֕מָת נָחָ֖שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֑וֹן וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was after thus, and died Nahash king of [the] sons of Ammon, and reigned his son in his place.

en.L: And it happened after this that Nahash the king of the sons of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.
en.B: Some time after this, Nahash king of the Ammonites died, and his son became king in his place.
en.R: Some time later, Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, died, and his son became the new king.

es.L: Y sucedió después de esto que murió Nahas, rey de los hijos de Amón, y reinó su hijo en su lugar.
es.B: Algún tiempo después, murió Nahas, rey de los amonitas, y su hijo reinó en su lugar.
es.R: Algún tiempo después, Nahas, el rey de los amonitas, murió, y su hijo llegó a ser el nuevo rey.

fr.L: Et il arriva après cela que Nahash, roi des fils d’Ammon, mourut, et son fils régna à sa place.
fr.B: Quelque temps après, Nahash, roi des Ammonites, mourut, et son fils devint roi à sa place.
fr.R: Quelque temps plus tard, Nahash, le roi des Ammonites, est mort, et son fils est devenu le nouveau roi.

sw.L: Ikawa baada ya hayo Nahashi mfalme wa wana wa Amoni akafa, naye mwanawe akatawala mahali pake.
sw.B: Baada ya hayo, Nahashi mfalme wa Waamoni alikufa, na mwanawe akawa mfalme mahali pake.
sw.R: Baadaye Nahashi, mfalme wa Waamoni, alikufa, na mwanawe akawa mfalme mpya.

vi.L: Sau việc này, Na-hách vua của con cháu Am-môn qua đời, và con trai vua lên trị vì thay cho cha.
vi.B: Sau đó ít lâu, Na-hách vua của người Am-môn qua đời, và con trai vua lên ngôi thay cho cha.
vi.R: Một thời gian sau, Na-hách, vua của người Am-môn, qua đời, và con trai vua lên làm vua mới.

ko.L: 그리고 그 뒤에 암몬 자손의 왕 나하스가 죽고, 그의 아들이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 얼마 뒤에 암몬 사람들의 왕 나하스가 죽고, 그의 아들이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 얼마 뒤에 암몬 사람들의 왕 나하스가 죽고, 그의 아들이 새 왕이 되었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu depois disso que Naás, rei dos filhos de Amom, morreu, e o seu filho reinou em seu lugar.
pt.B: Algum tempo depois, Naás, rei dos amonitas, morreu, e o seu filho se tornou rei no lugar dele.
pt.R: Algum tempo depois, Naás, o rei dos amonitas, morreu, e o filho dele se tornou o novo rei.

decisions.choice: 1 Chronicles 19:1-19 retells 2 Samuel 10:1-19
decisions.reason: This chapter follows 2 Samuel 10 closely, and each record notes where its words differ. Chronicles leaves out David's kindness to Saul's grandson Mephibosheth (2 Samuel 9), so here "after this" follows the summary of David's wars in chapter 18. In this verse Chronicles names the king who died, Nahash, and does not name his son until verse 2; 2 Samuel 10:1 names the son, Hanun, and leaves the father's name to its verse 2.

decisions.choice: after this: a loose link to what comes before, not a date
decisions.reason: The phrase opens a new story without saying how long after the events before it this happened. Chapter 18 has already summed up David's victories, among them his wars with Aram and the silver he took from Ammon (18:3-11); this chapter tells how the war with Ammon and its Aramean allies began.

decisions.choice: Nahash king of the Ammonites
decisions.reason: Ammon was a kingdom east of the Jordan, with its capital at Rabbah (20:1). Nahash had besieged Jabesh-gilead in the days of Saul (1 Samuel 11:1-11).

decisions.choice: the sons of Ammon (Literal); the Ammonites (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Sons of Ammon" is the usual Hebrew name for the people of Ammon. Literal keeps the phrase; Balanced and Readable use the people's name, as throughout this chapter and 2 Samuel 10.

decisions.choice: "암몬 자손" (L); "암몬 사람들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 10 in Korean, whose wording this chapter keeps wherever Chronicles has the same Hebrew; "자손" already includes the whole people, so no gender span is needed.

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 10:1, with "Naás" named and the son not named
decisions.reason: For 1 Chronicles 19, which retells 2 Samuel 10 (m1), the Portuguese of 2 Samuel 10 is kept level by level where the Hebrew is the same ("os filhos de Amom" at Literal, "os amonitas" at Balanced and Readable; "Hanum", "Naás"), and only what Chronicles changes is changed. Here Chronicles names the dead king, "Naás" as in 1 Samuel 11:1 in Portuguese, and leaves his son unnamed until verse 2.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר דָּוִ֜יד אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־חֶ֣סֶד׀עִם־חָנ֣וּן בֶּן־נָחָ֗שׁ כִּֽי־עָשָׂ֨ה אָבִ֤יו עִמִּי֙ חֶ֔סֶד וַיִּשְׁלַ֥ח דָּוִ֛יד מַלְאָכִ֖ים לְנַחֲמ֣וֹ עַל־אָבִ֑יו וַיָּבֹאוּ֩ עַבְדֵ֨י דָוִ֜יד אֶל־אֶ֧רֶץ בְּנֵי־עַמּ֛וֹן אֶל־חָנ֖וּן לְנַחֲמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said David, I will do chesed with Hanun son of Nahash, because did his father with me chesed; and sent David messengers to comfort him concerning his father; and came [the] servants of David to [the] land of [the] sons of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

en.L: And David said, "I will deal [in] steadfast love with Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father dealt [in] steadfast love with me." So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. And David's servants came into the land of the sons of Ammon, to Hanun, to comfort him.
en.B: David said, "I will show faithful love to Hanun son of Nahash, because his father showed faithful love to me." So David sent messengers to console Hanun over the death of his father. And David's officials came to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to console him.
en.R: David said, "Hanun's father Nahash showed faithful love to me. So I will show faithful love to his son Hanun." David sent messengers to comfort Hanun because his father had died. David's officials went to Hanun in the land of the Ammonites to comfort him.

es.L: Y dijo David: «Haré amor leal con Hanún hijo de Nahas, porque su padre hizo amor leal conmigo». Y envió David mensajeros para consolarlo acerca de su padre. Y llegaron los siervos de David a la tierra de los hijos de Amón, a Hanún, para consolarlo.
es.B: David dijo: «Mostraré amor fiel a Hanún hijo de Nahas, porque su padre me mostró amor fiel a mí». Así que David envió mensajeros para consolar a Hanún por la muerte de su padre. Y los oficiales de David llegaron a donde estaba Hanún, en la tierra de los amonitas, para consolarlo.
es.R: David dijo: «Nahas, el padre de Hanún, me mostró amor fiel. Por eso yo mostraré amor fiel a su hijo Hanún». David envió mensajeros para consolar a Hanún porque su padre había muerto. Los oficiales de David fueron a ver a Hanún en la tierra de los amonitas para consolarlo.

fr.L: Et David dit : « J’agirai avec amour loyal envers Hanoun, fils de Nahash, car son père a agi avec amour loyal envers moi. » Et David envoya des messagers le consoler au sujet de son père. Et les serviteurs de David arrivèrent au pays des fils d’Ammon, auprès de Hanoun, pour le consoler.
fr.B: David dit : « Je montrerai un amour fidèle à Hanoun, fils de Nahash, car son père m’a montré un amour fidèle. » David envoya donc des messagers consoler Hanoun de la mort de son père. Et les officiers de David arrivèrent auprès de Hanoun, au pays des Ammonites, pour le consoler.
fr.R: David a dit : « Nahash, le père de Hanoun, m’a montré un amour fidèle. Alors je vais montrer un amour fidèle à son fils Hanoun. » David a envoyé des messagers pour consoler Hanoun de la mort de son père. Les officiers de David sont allés au pays des Ammonites, auprès de Hanoun, pour le consoler.

sw.L: Daudi akasema, "Nitamtendea Hanuni mwana wa Nahashi upendo usiokoma, kwa sababu baba yake alinitendea upendo usiokoma." Basi Daudi akatuma wajumbe kumfariji kuhusu baba yake. Watumishi wa Daudi wakafika katika nchi ya wana wa Amoni, kwa Hanuni, kumfariji.
sw.B: Daudi akasema, "Nitamtendea Hanuni mwana wa Nahashi fadhili, kwa sababu baba yake alinitendea fadhili." Basi Daudi alituma wajumbe kumfariji Hanuni kwa kifo cha baba yake. Maafisa wa Daudi wakafika kwa Hanuni katika nchi ya Waamoni ili kumfariji.
sw.R: Daudi akasema, "Nahashi baba yake Hanuni alinitendea fadhili. Basi nami nitamtendea fadhili mwanawe Hanuni." Daudi akatuma wajumbe kumfariji Hanuni kwa sababu baba yake amekufa. Maafisa wa Daudi wakaenda kwa Hanuni katika nchi ya Waamoni kumfariji.

vi.L: Đa-vít nói: "Ta sẽ tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với Ha-nun con trai Na-hách, vì cha người đã tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với ta." Vậy Đa-vít sai sứ giả đi an ủi người về việc cha người. Các đầy tớ của Đa-vít đến xứ của con cháu Am-môn, đến với Ha-nun, để an ủi người.
vi.B: Đa-vít nói: "Ta sẽ tỏ lòng nhân từ với Ha-nun con trai Na-hách, vì cha người đã tỏ lòng nhân từ với ta." Vậy Đa-vít sai sứ giả đi chia buồn với Ha-nun về cái chết của cha người. Các quần thần của Đa-vít đến với Ha-nun tại xứ của người Am-môn để chia buồn với người.
vi.R: Đa-vít nói: "Na-hách, cha của Ha-nun, đã tỏ lòng nhân từ với ta. Vậy ta sẽ tỏ lòng nhân từ với Ha-nun con trai người." Đa-vít sai sứ giả đi chia buồn với Ha-nun vì cha người đã qua đời. Các quần thần của Đa-vít đến gặp Ha-nun tại xứ của người Am-môn để chia buồn với người.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 말했다. "그의 아버지가 나에게 한결같은 사랑을 베풀었으니, 내가 나하스의 아들 하눈에게 한결같은 사랑을 베풀겠다." 그래서 다윗이 그의 아버지 일로 그를 위로하려고 사자들을 보냈다. 그리고 다윗의 신하들이 하눈을 위로하려고 암몬 자손의 땅으로 하눈에게 왔다.
ko.B: 다윗이 말했다. "하눈의 아버지 나하스가 나에게 인애를 베풀었으니, 나도 그의 아들 하눈에게 인애를 베풀겠다." 그래서 다윗은 하눈이 아버지를 잃은 것을 위로하려고 사절들을 보냈다. 다윗의 신하들은 하눈을 위로하려고 암몬 사람들의 땅으로 그를 찾아갔다.
ko.R: 다윗이 말했다. "하눈의 아버지 나하스는 나에게 인애를 보여 주었다. 그러니 나도 그의 아들 하눈에게 인애를 보여 주겠다." 다윗은 하눈의 아버지가 죽었기 때문에 그를 위로하려고 사람들을 보냈다. 다윗의 신하들은 하눈을 위로하려고 암몬 사람들의 땅으로 갔다.

pt.L: E Davi disse: "Usarei de lealdade com Hanum, filho de Naás, porque o seu pai usou de lealdade comigo." E Davi enviou mensageiros para consolá-lo a respeito do seu pai. E os servos de Davi chegaram à terra dos filhos de Amom, a Hanum, para consolá-lo.
pt.B: Davi disse: "Vou mostrar lealdade a Hanum, filho de Naás, porque o pai dele mostrou lealdade a mim." Então Davi enviou mensageiros para consolar Hanum pela morte do pai. E os oficiais de Davi chegaram a Hanum, na terra dos amonitas, para consolá-lo.
pt.R: Davi disse: "Naás, o pai de Hanum, me tratou com bondade leal. Por isso vou tratar o seu filho Hanum com bondade leal." Davi mandou mensageiros para consolar Hanum, porque o pai dele tinha morrido. Os oficiais de Davi foram até Hanum, na terra dos amonitas, para consolá-lo.

decisions.choice: chesed: loyal kindness between allies
decisions.reason: Chesed is love that keeps faith within a bond (1 Samuel 20:8). Between two kings it is the loyalty of friends or treaty partners: Nahash had been good to David, and David means to keep up the friendship with his son. The same word is used of God's own love (Exodus 34:6).

decisions.choice: three small differences from 2 Samuel 10:2
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:2 says "just as his father showed chesed to me"; Chronicles says "because" he did, giving David's reason. Samuel says David sent "by the hand of his servants"; Chronicles says he sent "messengers", and then calls them David's servants. Chronicles also adds at the end that they came "to Hanun, to comfort him". The event is the same.

decisions.choice: because his father showed chesed to me: a kindness the Scriptures do not describe
decisions.reason: The text never says what Nahash had done for David. Nahash had been Saul's enemy (1 Samuel 11), so he may have helped David while Saul was hunting him. Later, when David fled from Absalom, Shobi son of Nahash of Rabbah brought him supplies (2 Samuel 17:27).

decisions.choice: sent to comfort him concerning his father: a formal embassy of condolence
decisions.reason: When a king died, friendly rulers sent envoys to mourn with his heir. Such a visit also confirmed that the friendship between the two kingdoms would go on under the new king.

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The word is rendered the same way throughout, as in Exodus 34:6 and 2 Samuel 10:2.

decisions.choice: servants (Literal); officials (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The servants of a king are his officials, here sent as envoys. Literal keeps "servants"; Balanced and Readable say "officials", as in 2 Samuel 10:2.

decisions.choice: siervos (L); oficiales (B, R)
decisions.reason: The king's servants are "siervos" at Literal and "oficiales" at Balanced and Readable, as in Samuel and Kings.

decisions.choice: wording of 2 Samuel 10 reused; "amour loyal" (L), "amour fidèle" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The chapter retells 2 Samuel 10, and the French of Samuel is kept where the Hebrew is the same; "car" renders Chronicles’ "because" where Samuel has "comme".

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L); "lòng nhân từ" (B, R)
decisions.reason: *Ḥesed* between people, as the Vietnamese 2 Samuel 10:2 renders it.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L); "인애" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's words for *ḥesed* between people, as 2 Samuel 10:2 in Korean.

decisions.choice: lealdade (L, B), bondade leal (R); porque; mensageiros
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:2 in Portuguese: "lealdade" at Literal and Balanced and "bondade leal" at Readable for chesed between allies (m1), "servos" (L) / "oficiais" (B, R). Chronicles' changes are kept (m2): "porque" for "assim como", "mensageiros" for "por meio dos seus servos", and the added "a Hanum, para consolá-lo".

source.text: וַיֹּאמְרוּ֩ שָׂרֵ֨י בְנֵי־עַמּ֜וֹן לְחָנ֗וּן הַֽמְכַבֵּ֨ד דָּוִ֤יד אֶת־אָבִ֨יךָ֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ כִּֽי־שָׁלַ֥ח לְךָ֖ מְנַחֲמִ֑ים הֲלֹ֡א בַּ֠עֲבוּר לַחְקֹ֨ר וְלַהֲפֹ֤ךְ וּלְרַגֵּל֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ בָּ֥אוּ עֲבָדָ֖יו אֵלֶֽיךָ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And said [the] princes of [the] sons of Ammon to Hanun, [Is] honoring David your father in your eyes because he has sent to you comforters? [Is it] not in order to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land [that] have come his servants to you?

en.L: And the princes of the sons of Ammon said to Hanun, "Is David honoring your father in your eyes because he has sent comforters to you? Is it not in order to search and to overthrow and to spy out the land that his servants have come to you?"
en.B: But the Ammonite officials said to Hanun, "Do you really think David is honoring your father by sending men to comfort you? Have his officials not come to you to explore, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?"
en.R: But the leaders of the Ammonites said to Hanun, "Do you really believe David sent these men to comfort you because he respects your father? No! His officials have come to look over the land and spy on it, so that he can conquer it."

es.L: Y dijeron los príncipes de los hijos de Amón a Hanún: «¿Honra David a tu padre a tus ojos porque te ha enviado consoladores? ¿No es para explorar y destruir y espiar la tierra que sus siervos han venido a ti?».
es.B: Pero los oficiales amonitas le dijeron a Hanún: «¿De veras crees que David honra a tu padre al enviarte hombres para consolarte? ¿No han venido a ti sus oficiales para explorar, destruir y espiar la tierra?».
es.R: Pero los líderes de los amonitas le dijeron a Hanún: «¿De veras crees que David envió a estos hombres a consolarte porque respeta a tu padre? ¡No! Sus oficiales han venido a recorrer la tierra y espiarla, para que él pueda conquistarla».

fr.L: Et les princes des fils d’Ammon dirent à Hanoun : « Est-ce pour honorer ton père, à tes yeux, que David t’a envoyé des consolateurs ? N’est-ce pas pour explorer, et pour renverser, et pour espionner le pays que ses serviteurs sont venus vers toi ? »
fr.B: Mais les chefs ammonites dirent à Hanoun : « Crois-tu vraiment que David veuille honorer ton père en t’envoyant des gens pour te consoler ? N’est-ce pas plutôt pour explorer le pays, le renverser et l’espionner que ses officiers sont venus vers toi ? »
fr.R: Mais les chefs des Ammonites ont dit à Hanoun : « Tu crois vraiment que David t’a envoyé ces hommes pour te consoler parce qu’il respecte ton père ? Non ! Ses officiers sont venus pour observer le pays et l’espionner, afin qu’il puisse s’en emparer. »

sw.L: Wakuu wa wana wa Amoni wakamwambia Hanuni, "Je, Daudi anamheshimu baba yako machoni pako kwa kuwa amekutumia wafariji? Je, si kwa ajili ya kuchunguza na kuangamiza na kuipeleleza nchi kwamba watumishi wake wamekuja kwako?"
sw.B: Lakini maafisa wa Waamoni wakamwambia Hanuni, "Je, kweli unadhani Daudi anamheshimu baba yako kwa kukutumia watu wa kukufariji? Je, maafisa wake hawakuja kwako ili kuichunguza nchi, kuipeleleza na kuiangamiza?"
sw.R: Lakini viongozi wa Waamoni wakamwambia Hanuni, "Je, kweli unaamini kwamba Daudi amewatuma watu hawa kukufariji kwa sababu anamheshimu baba yako? Hapana! Maafisa wake wamekuja kuikagua nchi na kuipeleleza, ili apate kuiteka."

vi.L: Các thủ lĩnh của con cháu Am-môn nói với Ha-nun: "Có phải trong mắt bệ hạ, Đa-vít tôn kính cha bệ hạ vì hắn đã sai người đến an ủi bệ hạ sao? Chẳng phải các đầy tớ hắn đến với bệ hạ để dò xét, lật đổ và do thám xứ sao?"
vi.B: Nhưng các quan chức của người Am-môn nói với Ha-nun: "Bệ hạ thật sự nghĩ rằng Đa-vít tôn kính cha bệ hạ khi sai người đến chia buồn với bệ hạ sao? Chẳng phải các quần thần của hắn đến với bệ hạ để dò xét, lật đổ và do thám xứ này sao?"
vi.R: Nhưng các nhà lãnh đạo của người Am-môn nói với Ha-nun: "Đức vua thật sự tin rằng Đa-vít sai những người này đến chia buồn vì hắn kính trọng cha của đức vua sao? Không đâu! Quần thần của hắn đến để xem xét và do thám xứ này, để hắn chiếm lấy nó."

ko.L: 그리고 암몬 자손의 고관들이 하눈에게 말했다. "다윗이 당신에게 위로하는 자들을 보냈다고 해서, 당신 눈에는 그가 당신의 아버지를 존경하는 것[으로 보입니까]? 그의 신하들이 이 땅을 살피고 뒤엎고 정탐하려고 당신에게 온 것이 아닙니까?"
ko.B: 그러나 암몬의 고관들이 하눈에게 말했다. "다윗이 위로하는 사람들을 보냈다고 해서, 정말로 그가 임금님의 아버지를 존경한다고 생각하십니까? 그의 신하들은 이 땅을 살피고 무너뜨리고 정탐하려고 임금님께 온 것이 아니겠습니까?"
ko.R: 그러나 암몬의 지도자들이 하눈에게 말했다. "다윗이 임금님의 아버지를 존경해서 위로하는 사람들을 보냈다고 정말 믿으십니까? 아닙니다! 다윗의 신하들은 이 땅을 둘러보고 정탐하러 왔습니다. 다윗이 이 땅을 빼앗으려는 것입니다."

pt.L: E os príncipes dos filhos de Amom disseram a Hanum: "Acaso Davi está honrando o seu pai aos seus olhos, porque lhe enviou consoladores? Não foi para examinar, e destruir, e espionar a terra que os servos dele vieram até o senhor?"
pt.B: Mas os oficiais amonitas disseram a Hanum: "O senhor acha mesmo que Davi está honrando o seu pai ao mandar homens para consolá-lo? Os oficiais dele não vieram ao senhor para explorar, destruir e espionar a terra?"
pt.R: Mas os líderes dos amonitas disseram a Hanum: "O senhor acredita mesmo que Davi mandou esses homens para consolá-lo porque respeita o seu pai? Não! Os oficiais dele vieram para examinar a terra e espioná-la, para que Davi possa conquistá-la."

decisions.choice: is David honoring your father in your eyes?: do you think he is?
decisions.reason: "In your eyes" means "in your opinion". The question expects the answer "no": the officials are telling Hanun not to believe that the visit is a mark of respect.

decisions.choice: is it not in order to ...?: a question that states what they believe
decisions.reason: The second question expects the answer "yes". The officials claim the envoys came as spies.

decisions.choice: differences from 2 Samuel 10:3
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:3 calls Hanun "their lord", speaks of "the city", lists the verbs as search, spy out and overthrow, and says "David has sent his servants". Chronicles leaves out "their lord", speaks of "the land", puts "overthrow" before "spy out", and says "his servants have come". The charge is the same: the envoys are spies.

decisions.choice: search, overthrow, spy out: scout the land in order to take it
decisions.reason: Together the three verbs say that the visit was a first step toward conquest; their order here is not a sequence of events. The fear was not far-fetched, since David had just conquered Moab, Aram and Edom (18:2-13).

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); officials (Balanced); leaders (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word names the chief men around a king. The three levels follow the wording settled for this word in Samuel and 2 Samuel 10:3.

decisions.choice: No! His officials have come to ...
decisions.reason: Readable turns the second question into the statement it implies, so that young readers do not miss the point.

decisions.choice: nchi
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "the land" where 2 Samuel 10:3 has "the city"; the Swahili of Samuel changes this word.

decisions.choice: the officials call Hanun "임금님" at Balanced and Readable; Literal keeps "당신"
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 10:3 in Korean: courtiers address their king by title, and "당신" to a king would sound rude.

decisions.choice: os príncipes (L), os oficiais (B), os líderes (R); o senhor; a terra; examinar, destruir, espionar
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:3 in Portuguese (the three words for the officials; "o senhor" as the officials speak up to their king), with Chronicles' changes (m3): no "seu senhor" after Hanum's name, "a terra" for "a cidade", "destruir" before "espionar", and "os servos dele" for "Davi ... os seus servos".

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח חָנ֜וּן אֶת־עַבְדֵ֤י דָוִיד֙ וַֽיְגַלְּחֵ֔ם וַיִּכְרֹ֧ת אֶת־מַדְוֵיהֶ֛ם בַּחֵ֖צִי עַד־הַמִּפְשָׂעָ֑ה וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And took Hanun [the] servants of David and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle as far as the buttocks, and sent them away.

en.L: So Hanun took David's servants and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle, as far as the buttocks, and sent them away.
en.B: So Hanun seized David's officials, shaved them, cut their garments off in the middle at the buttocks, and sent them on their way.
en.R: So Hanun took David's officials and shaved them. He cut their robes short, so that their backsides were left bare. Then he sent them away.

es.L: Entonces Hanún tomó a los siervos de David y los rapó, y les cortó los vestidos por la mitad, hasta las nalgas, y los despidió.
es.B: Así que Hanún apresó a los oficiales de David, los rapó, les cortó los vestidos por la mitad a la altura de las nalgas y los despidió.
es.R: Así que Hanún tomó a los oficiales de David y los afeitó. Les cortó la ropa tan corta que les quedaron las nalgas al descubierto. Luego los despidió.

fr.L: Et Hanoun prit les serviteurs de David et les rasa, et coupa leurs vêtements par le milieu jusqu’aux fesses, et les renvoya.
fr.B: Hanoun se saisit donc des officiers de David, les fit raser, fit couper leurs vêtements par le milieu, à hauteur des fesses, et les renvoya.
fr.R: Alors Hanoun a fait prendre les officiers de David et il les a fait raser. Il a fait couper leurs robes très court, si bien qu’on voyait leurs fesses. Puis il les a renvoyés.

sw.L: Basi Hanuni akawatwaa watumishi wa Daudi akawanyoa, akayakata mavazi yao katikati mpaka matakoni, akawaacha waende.
sw.B: Basi Hanuni aliwakamata maafisa wa Daudi, akawanyoa, akayakata mavazi yao katikati hadi matakoni, akawaacha waende.
sw.R: Basi Hanuni akawakamata maafisa wa Daudi, akawanyoa. Akayakata mavazi yao mafupi, hata matako yao yakabaki wazi. Kisha akawaacha waende.

vi.L: Vậy Ha-nun bắt các đầy tớ của Đa-vít, cạo [râu] họ, cắt áo họ ở giữa cho đến mông, rồi đuổi họ đi.
vi.B: Vậy Ha-nun bắt các quần thần của Đa-vít, cạo râu họ, cắt áo họ ngang giữa cho đến mông, rồi đuổi họ đi.
vi.R: Vậy Ha-nun bắt các quần thần của Đa-vít và cạo râu họ. Hắn cắt ngắn áo họ đến nỗi phía sau bị hở mông. Rồi hắn đuổi họ đi.

ko.L: 그래서 하눈이 다윗의 신하들을 붙잡아 그들의 [수염을] 깎고, 그들의 옷을 엉덩이까지 중간을 잘라 내고, 그들을 돌려보냈다.
ko.B: 그래서 하눈은 다윗의 신하들을 붙잡아 수염을 깎고, 그들의 옷을 엉덩이가 드러나도록 중간을 잘라 낸 뒤에 돌려보냈다.
ko.R: 그래서 하눈은 다윗의 신하들을 붙잡아 수염을 깎아 버렸다. 그리고 그들의 옷을 짧게 잘라서 엉덩이가 드러나게 했다. 그러고는 그들을 돌려보냈다.

pt.L: Então Hanum tomou os servos de Davi, e os raspou, e cortou as suas roupas pelo meio, até as nádegas, e os despediu.
pt.B: Então Hanum prendeu os oficiais de Davi, raspou a barba deles, cortou as roupas deles pelo meio, na altura das nádegas, e os mandou embora.
pt.R: Então Hanum pegou os oficiais de Davi e raspou a barba deles. Mandou cortar as roupas deles bem curtas, de modo que ficaram com o traseiro de fora. Depois os mandou embora.

decisions.choice: shaved them: 2 Samuel 10:4 says he shaved off half of their beard
decisions.reason: Chronicles says only that Hanun shaved the men; 2 Samuel 10:4 says he shaved off half of each man's beard. The beard is meant here too, since in verse 5 David tells the men to wait until their beards grow back. Chronicles also uses a different and rare word for the buttocks, found only here; it names the same part of the body.

decisions.choice: shaving the envoys: a deliberate public insult
decisions.reason: A full beard was a mark of a grown man's honor. Men cut their beards only in deep mourning or disgrace (Isaiah 15:2; Jeremiah 48:37). Shaving the envoys by force made them look ridiculous, and the insult fell on David, who had sent them.

decisions.choice: cutting their garments to the buttocks: stripping them like captives
decisions.reason: Long robes were the dress of men of standing. Cutting them off at the buttocks left the men exposed, the shame done to prisoners of war (Isaiah 20:4). To treat a king's envoys this way was to reject his friendship and amounted to a challenge to war.

decisions.choice: He cut their robes short, so that their backsides were left bare
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the cut did, which is the point of the insult, as in 2 Samuel 10:4.

decisions.choice: os raspou (L); raspou a barba deles (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says only "shaved them" where 2 Samuel 10:4 says "metade da barba" (m1). Literal keeps "os raspou"; "raspar" with a person as object is unclear in Portuguese, so Balanced and Readable name the beard, which verse 5 shows is meant, without 2 Samuel's "metade". The rest is 2 Samuel 10:4 in Portuguese ("nádegas", "o traseiro de fora").

source.text: וַיֵּלְכוּ֩ וַיַּגִּ֨ידוּ לְדָוִ֤יד עַל־הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח לִקְרָאתָ֔ם כִּי־הָי֥וּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים נִכְלָמִ֣ים מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֤אמֶר הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ שְׁב֣וּ בִֽירֵח֔וֹ עַ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־יְצַמַּ֥ח זְקַנְכֶ֖ם וְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they went and told David about the men, and he sent to meet them, for were the men humiliated greatly. And said the king, Stay in Jericho until that grows your beard, and you will return.

en.L: And they went and told David about the men, and he sent to meet them, for the men were greatly humiliated. And the king said, "Stay in Jericho until your beard has grown, and [then] return."
en.B: When people came and told David what had happened to the men, he sent messengers to meet them, because the men were deeply ashamed. The king said, "Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then come home."
en.R: Some people went and told David what had happened to the men. So he sent messengers to meet them, because they were so ashamed. The king told them, "Wait in Jericho until your beards grow again. Then come home."

es.L: Y fueron y le informaron a David acerca de los hombres, y él envió a su encuentro, porque los hombres estaban muy avergonzados. Y dijo el rey: «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} en Jericó hasta que {{plural_you:les|os}} crezca la barba, y [después] {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}}».
es.B: Cuando fueron a contarle a David lo que había pasado con los hombres, él envió mensajeros a su encuentro, porque los hombres estaban muy avergonzados. El rey les dijo: «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} en Jericó hasta que {{plural_you:les|os}} vuelva a crecer la barba, y después {{plural_you:regresen|regresad}} a casa».
es.R: Algunos fueron y le contaron a David lo que había pasado con los hombres. Entonces él envió gente a recibirlos, porque estaban muy avergonzados. El rey les dijo: «{{plural_you:Esperen|Esperad}} en Jericó hasta que {{plural_you:les|os}} crezca otra vez la barba. Después {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a casa».

fr.L: Et on alla informer David au sujet de ces hommes, et il envoya [des gens] à leur rencontre, car les hommes étaient très humiliés. Et le roi dit : « Restez à Jéricho jusqu’à ce que votre barbe ait poussé, et [ensuite] revenez. »
fr.B: Quand on vint raconter à David ce qui était arrivé à ces hommes, il envoya des messagers à leur rencontre, car ces hommes étaient profondément humiliés. Le roi leur fit dire : « Restez à Jéricho jusqu’à ce que votre barbe ait repoussé, puis revenez. »
fr.R: Des gens sont allés raconter à David ce qui était arrivé à ces hommes. Alors il a envoyé des messagers à leur rencontre, parce qu’ils avaient très honte. Le roi leur a fait dire : « Attendez à Jéricho que votre barbe ait repoussé. Ensuite, rentrez. »

sw.L: Wakaenda wakamwambia Daudi habari za watu hao, naye akatuma kuwalaki, kwa maana watu hao walikuwa wameaibishwa sana. Mfalme akasema, "Kaeni Yeriko mpaka ndevu zenu zitakapoota, [ndipo] mrudi."
sw.B: Watu walipokuja kumwambia Daudi yaliyowapata watu hao, alituma wajumbe kuwalaki, kwa sababu watu hao waliona aibu kubwa. Mfalme akasema, "Kaeni Yeriko mpaka ndevu zenu zitakapoota tena, kisha mrudi nyumbani."
sw.R: Watu fulani walikwenda kumwambia Daudi yaliyowapata watu hao. Basi alituma wajumbe wakawalaki, kwa sababu waliona aibu sana. Mfalme akawaambia, "Ngojeni Yeriko mpaka ndevu zenu ziote tena. Kisha mrudi nyumbani."

vi.L: Người ta đi báo cho Đa-vít về những người ấy, và ông sai người đi đón họ, vì những người ấy bị sỉ nhục quá đỗi. Vua nói: "Hãy ở lại Giê-ri-cô cho đến khi râu các ngươi mọc lại, rồi hãy trở về."
vi.B: Khi có người đến báo cho Đa-vít biết chuyện đã xảy ra cho những người ấy, ông sai sứ giả đi đón họ, vì họ rất hổ thẹn. Vua nói: "Hãy ở lại Giê-ri-cô cho đến khi râu các ngươi mọc lại, rồi hãy trở về."
vi.R: Có người đi báo cho Đa-vít biết chuyện đã xảy ra cho những người ấy. Vì vậy ông sai người đi đón họ, vì họ rất xấu hổ. Vua bảo họ: "Hãy chờ ở Giê-ri-cô cho đến khi râu các ngươi mọc lại. Rồi hãy về nhà."

ko.L: 그리고 사람들이 가서 그 사람들에 관하여 다윗에게 알리자, 그가 [사람을] 보내어 그들을 맞이했다. 그 사람들이 크게 모욕을 당했기 때문이다. 그리고 왕이 말했다. "너희 수염이 자랄 때까지 여리고에 머물다가 돌아오너라."
ko.B: 사람들이 와서 그 사람들이 당한 일을 다윗에게 알리자, 그는 사람들을 보내 그들을 맞이하게 했다. 그들이 몹시 수치를 당했기 때문이다. 왕이 말했다. "수염이 다시 자랄 때까지 여리고에 머물러 있다가 돌아오너라."
ko.R: 어떤 사람들이 가서 그 사람들이 당한 일을 다윗에게 알렸다. 다윗은 사람들을 보내 그들을 맞이했다. 그들이 너무나 부끄러워했기 때문이다. 왕이 그들에게 말했다. "수염이 다시 자랄 때까지 여리고에서 기다려라. 그런 다음에 돌아오너라."

pt.L: E foram e contaram a Davi a respeito dos homens, e ele mandou [gente] ao encontro deles, porque os homens estavam muito humilhados. E o rei disse: "Fiquem em Jericó até que a barba de vocês cresça, e [então] voltem."
pt.B: Quando foram contar a Davi o que tinha acontecido aos homens, ele enviou mensageiros ao encontro deles, porque os homens estavam profundamente envergonhados. O rei disse: "Fiquem em Jericó até que a barba de vocês cresça de novo, e então voltem para casa."
pt.R: Algumas pessoas foram contar a Davi o que tinha acontecido aos homens. Então ele mandou mensageiros se encontrarem com eles, porque eles estavam muito envergonhados. O rei disse a eles: "Esperem em Jericó até a barba de vocês crescer outra vez. Depois voltem para casa."

decisions.choice: they went and told David about the men: a fuller form of 2 Samuel 10:5
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:5 says only "they told David". Chronicles adds "they went" and "about the men". Neither book says who went; it may have been the envoys themselves or others who saw them. The king's words are the same in both books.

decisions.choice: greatly humiliated: publicly disgraced
decisions.reason: The word describes the shame of being dishonored in front of others, not only a private feeling of embarrassment.

decisions.choice: stay in Jericho: wait out of sight on the way home
decisions.reason: Jericho lay just west of the Jordan, on the road from Ammon up to Jerusalem. By waiting there the envoys were spared being seen in the capital until they looked like themselves again. David's care for them also shows that he took the insult as his own.

decisions.choice: people came (Balanced); some people went (Readable); he sent messengers
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "they went" and "he sent". Balanced and Readable say who went and who was sent, which the verbs imply.

decisions.choice: foram e contaram ... a respeito dos homens
decisions.reason: The king's words keep 2 Samuel 10:5 in Portuguese at every level. The opening has Chronicles' fuller wording (m1): "foram" and "a respeito dos homens" (L), "o que tinha acontecido aos homens" (B, R); Readable says "algumas pessoas", as the English does.

source.text: וַיִּרְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן כִּ֥י הִֽתְבָּאֲשׁ֖וּ עִם־דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח חָ֠נוּן וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֜וֹן אֶ֣לֶף כִּכַּר־כֶּ֗סֶף לִשְׂכֹּ֣ר לָ֠הֶם מִן־אֲרַ֨ם נַהֲרַ֜יִם וּמִן־אֲרַ֤ם מַעֲכָה֙ וּמִצּוֹבָ֔ה רֶ֖כֶב וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw [the] sons of Ammon that they had made themselves odious with David, and sent Hanun and [the] sons of Ammon a thousand talents of silver to hire for themselves from Aram-naharaim and from Aram-maacah and from Zobah chariots and horsemen.

en.L: And the sons of Ammon saw that they had made themselves a stench to David, and Hanun and the sons of Ammon sent 1,000 talents of silver to hire for themselves chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim and from Aram-maacah and from Zobah.
en.B: When the Ammonites saw that they had made themselves hateful to David, Hanun and the Ammonites sent {{units:about 37 tons|1,000 talents}} of silver to hire chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah and Zobah.
en.R: The Ammonites knew that they had made David their enemy. So Hanun and the Ammonites sent {{units:about 37 tons|1,000 talents}} of silver to hire chariots and horsemen from northern Mesopotamia, Maacah and Zobah.

es.L: Y vieron los hijos de Amón que se habían hecho odiosos a David, y Hanún y los hijos de Amón enviaron 1 000 talentos de plata para tomar a sueldo carros y jinetes de Aram-naharaim y de Aram-maaca y de Soba.
es.B: Cuando los amonitas vieron que se habían ganado el odio de David, Hanún y los amonitas enviaron {{units:unas 34 toneladas|1 000 talentos}} de plata para contratar carros y jinetes de Aram-naharaim, Aram-maaca y Soba.
es.R: Los amonitas sabían que se habían convertido en enemigos de David. Así que Hanún y los amonitas enviaron {{units:unas 34 toneladas|1 000 talentos}} de plata para contratar carros y jinetes del norte de Mesopotamia, de Maaca y de Soba.

fr.L: Et les fils d’Ammon virent qu’ils s’étaient rendus odieux à David, et Hanoun et les fils d’Ammon envoyèrent 1 000 talents d’argent pour prendre à leur solde des chars et des cavaliers d’Aram-Naharaïm, et d’Aram-Maaka, et de Soba.
fr.B: Quand les Ammonites virent qu’ils s’étaient rendus odieux à David, Hanoun et les Ammonites envoyèrent {{units:environ 34 tonnes|mille talents}} d’argent pour prendre à leur solde des chars et des cavaliers d’Aram-Naharaïm, d’Aram-Maaka et de Soba.
fr.R: Les Ammonites ont compris qu’ils avaient fait de David leur ennemi. Alors Hanoun et les Ammonites ont envoyé {{units:environ 34 tonnes|mille talents}} d’argent pour payer des chars et des cavaliers du nord de la Mésopotamie, de Maaka et de Soba.

sw.L: Wana wa Amoni wakaona kwamba wamejifanya kuwa uvundo kwa Daudi, nao Hanuni na wana wa Amoni wakatuma talanta 1,000 za fedha kujiajiria magari na wapanda farasi kutoka Aramu-naharaimu na kutoka Aramu-maaka na kutoka Soba.
sw.B: Waamoni walipoona kwamba wamejifanya kuwa chukizo kwa Daudi, Hanuni na Waamoni walituma {{units:karibu tani 34|talanta 1,000}} za fedha ili kuajiri magari ya vita na wapanda farasi kutoka Aramu-naharaimu, Aramu-maaka na Soba.
sw.R: Waamoni walijua kwamba wamemfanya Daudi kuwa adui yao. Basi Hanuni na Waamoni wakatuma {{units:karibu tani 34|talanta 1,000}} za fedha ili kuajiri magari ya vita na wapanda farasi kutoka kaskazini mwa Mesopotamia, Maaka na Soba.

vi.L: Con cháu Am-môn thấy mình đã trở nên đáng ghê tởm đối với Đa-vít, thì Ha-nun và con cháu Am-môn gửi 1.000 ta-lâng bạc để thuê cho mình xe chiến mã và kỵ binh từ A-ram Na-ha-ra-im, từ A-ram Ma-a-ca và từ Xô-ba.
vi.B: Khi người Am-môn thấy mình đã trở thành kẻ thù đáng ghét của Đa-vít, Ha-nun và người Am-môn gửi {{units:khoảng 34 tấn|1.000 ta-lâng}} bạc để thuê xe chiến mã và kỵ binh từ A-ram Na-ha-ra-im, A-ram Ma-a-ca và Xô-ba.
vi.R: Người Am-môn biết mình đã khiến Đa-vít trở thành kẻ thù. Vì vậy Ha-nun và người Am-môn gửi {{units:khoảng 34 tấn|1.000 ta-lâng}} bạc để thuê xe chiến mã và kỵ binh từ miền bắc Lưỡng Hà, từ Ma-a-ca và từ Xô-ba.

ko.L: 그리고 암몬 자손이 자기들이 다윗에게 악취가 되었다는 것을 보았다. 그래서 하눈과 암몬 자손이 은 천 달란트를 보내어, 아람나하라임과 아람마아가와 소바에서 병거와 기병을 고용했다.
ko.B: 암몬 사람들은 자기들이 다윗에게 미움을 사게 된 것을 알았다. 그래서 하눈과 암몬 사람들은 은 {{units:34,000킬로그램쯤|천 달란트}}을 보내어, 아람나하라임과 아람마아가와 소바에서 병거와 기병을 고용했다.
ko.R: 암몬 사람들은 자기들이 다윗을 원수로 만들었다는 것을 알았다. 그래서 하눈과 암몬 사람들은 은 {{units:34,000킬로그램쯤|천 달란트}}을 보내어, 메소포타미아 북쪽과 마아가와 소바에서 병거와 기병을 고용했다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Amom viram que se tinham tornado um mau cheiro para Davi, e Hanum e os filhos de Amom enviaram mil talentos de prata para contratar para si carros e cavaleiros de Arã-Naaraim, e de Arã-Maaca, e de Zobá.
pt.B: Quando os amonitas viram que tinham se tornado odiosos para Davi, Hanum e os amonitas enviaram {{units:cerca de 34 toneladas|mil talentos}} de prata para contratar carros e cavaleiros de Arã-Naaraim, de Arã-Maaca e de Zobá.
pt.R: Os amonitas sabiam que tinham feito de Davi um inimigo. Por isso Hanum e os amonitas mandaram {{units:cerca de 34 toneladas|mil talentos}} de prata para contratar carros e cavaleiros do norte da Mesopotâmia, de Maaca e de Zobá.

decisions.choice: made themselves a stench to David: turned David into an enemy
decisions.reason: To become a bad smell to someone is to become hateful to him (Genesis 34:30; 1 Samuel 27:12; 2 Samuel 10:6). The Ammonites knew war would follow.

decisions.choice: the forces hired differ from 2 Samuel 10:6
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:6 says the Ammonites hired 20,000 foot soldiers from the Arameans of Beth-rehob and of Zobah, the king of Maacah with 1,000 men, and 12,000 men of Tob. Chronicles names Hanun as one of those who sent, gives the price, a thousand talents of silver, and says they hired chariots and horsemen from Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah and Zobah; it does not name Beth-rehob or Tob. The two writers drew on different records or counted the forces differently.

decisions.choice: Aram-naharaim, Aram-maacah and Zobah: Aramean lands to the north and northeast
decisions.reason: Aram-naharaim, "Aram of the two rivers", was the land of the upper Euphrates in northern Mesopotamia, where Nahor's family lived (Genesis 24:10) and from which Cushan-rishathaim came (Judges 3:8). Aram-maacah, or Maacah, lay near the Golan, east of the upper Jordan (Deuteronomy 3:14). Zobah was the kingdom of Hadadezer (18:3).

decisions.choice: a thousand talents of silver: an enormous sum
decisions.reason: A talent was the largest weight, about 75 pounds. A thousand talents of silver was a king's ransom; Menahem paid the same amount to the king of Assyria (2 Kings 15:19).

decisions.choice: about 37 tons (1,000 talents)
decisions.reason: A talent was about 75 pounds, so a thousand talents was about 75,000 pounds. Literal keeps the Hebrew unit; Balanced and Readable give the modern measure with the talent as the alternative, as in 2 Kings 15:19.

decisions.choice: northern Mesopotamia; Maacah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names Aram-naharaim by the region it was, as in Genesis 24:10, and calls Aram-maacah simply Maacah, as verse 7 does.

decisions.choice: unas 34 toneladas (1 000 talentos)
decisions.reason: A talent is reckoned at 34 kg, as in the Spanish of Kings, so a thousand talents is about 34 tonnes; the English, in American tons, says "about 37 tons".

decisions.choice: "environ 34 tonnes"
decisions.reason: French converts the talent at 34 kg, as the Kings terms note sets; the English default uses a different value and US tons.

decisions.choice: karibu tani 34 (talanta 1,000)
decisions.reason: The metric default is 34 tonnes (a talent is about 34 kg), where the English default gives US tons; Literal keeps "talanta 1,000".

decisions.choice: {{units:khoảng 34 tấn|1.000 ta-lâng}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default at the terms note's 34 kg a talent, the original unit as the alternative; the English's "37 tons" are US tons.

decisions.choice: {{units:34,000킬로그램쯤|천 달란트}}
decisions.reason: Korean gives the metric weight by default (talent 34 kg), with the original unit as the alternative; Literal keeps "천 달란트".

decisions.choice: "메소포타미아 북쪽"
decisions.reason: Readable names Aram-naharaim by the region it was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: cerca de 34 toneladas (mil talentos)
decisions.reason: Metric by default, with the talent as the alternative, as the English converts it: a talent is about 34 kg, so a thousand talents are about 34 toneladas, the same figure as 2 Kings 15:19 in Portuguese. Literal keeps "mil talentos".

decisions.choice: um mau cheiro (L), odiosos (B); Arã-Naaraim (L, B), o norte da Mesopotâmia (R); Arã-Maaca
decisions.reason: "Um mau cheiro" and "odiosos" as 2 Samuel 10:6 in Portuguese (m1). The hired lands are Chronicles' own (m2, m3): "Arã-Naaraim" as Genesis 24:10 and Judges 3:8 in Portuguese, which Readable calls "o norte da Mesopotâmia" as Genesis 24:10 does; "Arã-Maaca" joins "Arã" to the "Maaca" of 2 Samuel 10:6.

source.text: וַיִּשְׂכְּר֣וּ לָהֶ֡ם שְׁנַיִם֩ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים אֶ֜לֶף רֶ֗כֶב וְאֶת־מֶ֤לֶךְ מַעֲכָה֙ וְאֶת־עַמּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י מֵידְבָ֑א וּבְנֵ֣י עַמּ֗וֹן נֶאֶסְפוּ֙ מֵעָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ לַמִּלְחָמָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariot[s], and [the] king of Maacah and his people; and they came and camped before Medeba. And [the] sons of Ammon were gathered from their cities and came to the battle.

en.L: And they hired for themselves 32,000 chariots, and the king of Maacah and his people; and they came and camped before Medeba. And the sons of Ammon were gathered from their cities and came to the battle.
en.B: They hired 32,000 chariots and the king of Maacah with his army, and these came and camped near Medeba. The Ammonites also gathered from their cities and came out to fight.
en.R: They hired 32,000 chariots and the king of Maacah with his army. These forces came and set up camp near the town of Medeba. The Ammonites also came together from their towns and got ready for battle.

es.L: Y tomaron a sueldo 32 000 carros, y al rey de Maaca y a su pueblo; y vinieron y acamparon delante de Medeba. Y los hijos de Amón se reunieron de sus ciudades y vinieron a la batalla.
es.B: Contrataron 32 000 carros y al rey de Maaca con su ejército, y estos vinieron y acamparon cerca de Medeba. Los amonitas también se reunieron de sus ciudades y salieron a pelear.
es.R: Contrataron 32 000 carros y al rey de Maaca con su ejército. Estas fuerzas vinieron y acamparon cerca de la ciudad de Medeba. Los amonitas también se juntaron de sus ciudades y se prepararon para la batalla.

fr.L: Et ils prirent à leur solde 32 000 chars, et le roi de Maaka et son peuple ; et ils vinrent et campèrent devant Médeba. Et les fils d’Ammon se rassemblèrent de leurs villes et vinrent au combat.
fr.B: Ils prirent à leur solde 32 000 chars, ainsi que le roi de Maaka avec son armée, et ceux-ci vinrent camper près de Médeba. Les Ammonites, eux aussi, se rassemblèrent de leurs villes et sortirent pour combattre.
fr.R: Ils ont pris à leur solde 32 000 chars et le roi de Maaka avec son armée. Ces troupes sont venues installer leur camp près de la ville de Médeba. Les Ammonites, eux aussi, se sont rassemblés de toutes leurs villes et se sont préparés au combat.

sw.L: Wakajiajiria magari 32,000, na mfalme wa Maaka na watu wake; wakaja wakapiga kambi mbele ya Medeba. Nao wana wa Amoni wakakusanyika kutoka miji yao wakaja vitani.
sw.B: Waliajiri magari ya vita 32,000 na mfalme wa Maaka pamoja na jeshi lake, nao wakaja wakapiga kambi karibu na Medeba. Waamoni nao wakakusanyika kutoka miji yao, wakatoka kwenda vitani.
sw.R: Waliajiri magari ya vita 32,000 na mfalme wa Maaka pamoja na jeshi lake. Majeshi hayo yakaja yakapiga kambi karibu na mji wa Medeba. Waamoni nao wakakusanyika kutoka miji yao, wakajiandaa kwa vita.

vi.L: Họ thuê cho mình 32.000 cỗ xe, cùng vua Ma-a-ca và dân của vua; họ đến và đóng trại trước Mê-đê-ba. Con cháu Am-môn cũng tập hợp lại từ các thành của mình và kéo ra trận.
vi.B: Họ thuê 32.000 cỗ xe cùng vua Ma-a-ca với quân đội của vua, và những người này đến đóng trại gần Mê-đê-ba. Người Am-môn cũng tập hợp lại từ các thành của mình và kéo ra giao chiến.
vi.R: Họ thuê 32.000 cỗ xe cùng vua Ma-a-ca với quân đội của vua. Những đạo quân này đến đóng trại gần thành Mê-đê-ba. Người Am-môn cũng tập hợp lại từ các thành của mình và chuẩn bị giao chiến.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 자기들을 위하여 병거 32,000[대]와 마아가 왕과 그의 백성을 고용했다. 그리고 그들이 와서 메드바 앞에 진을 쳤다. 그리고 암몬 자손이 자기들의 성읍들에서 모여 싸우러 왔다.
ko.B: 그들은 병거 32,000대와 마아가 왕과 그의 군대를 고용했다. 그들이 와서 메드바 가까이에 진을 쳤다. 암몬 사람들도 자기들의 성읍에서 모여 싸우러 나왔다.
ko.R: 그들은 병거 32,000대와 마아가 왕과 그의 군대를 고용했다. 이 군대들이 와서 메드바 성 가까이에 진을 쳤다. 암몬 사람들도 자기들의 성읍에서 모여 싸울 준비를 했다.

pt.L: E contrataram para si trinta e dois mil carros, e o rei de Maaca e o seu povo; e vieram e acamparam diante de Medeba. E os filhos de Amom se reuniram das suas cidades e vieram para a batalha.
pt.B: Contrataram trinta e dois mil carros e o rei de Maaca com o seu exército, e estes vieram e acamparam perto de Medeba. Os amonitas também se reuniram das suas cidades e saíram para lutar.
pt.R: Eles contrataram trinta e dois mil carros e o rei de Maaca com o seu exército. Essas tropas vieram e montaram acampamento perto da cidade de Medeba. Os amonitas também se reuniram, vindos das suas cidades, e se prepararam para a batalha.

decisions.choice: 32,000 chariots: chariot forces, a very large number
decisions.reason: The word means chariots or chariotry, the chariots with their crews and horses. The number is far beyond the chariot forces of any king of the time. The word for "thousand" may also name a military unit, as noted at Numbers 1, and numbers were easily miscopied.

decisions.choice: the king of Maacah and Medeba: compare 2 Samuel 10:6
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:6 says the king of Maacah brought 1,000 men; Chronicles says "his people" without a number. The forces Samuel lists add up to 33,000 men, close to the 32,000 here, so the two books may be counting the same army in different ways. Only Chronicles says where the hired forces camped, before Medeba, and that the Ammonites gathered from their cities.

decisions.choice: Medeba: a town on the plateau east of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Medeba lay about twenty miles southwest of Rabbah, Ammon's capital, on the high plain north of the Arnon (Numbers 21:30; Joshua 13:9, 16). The hired army camped there, at a distance from the Ammonites, which fits the two separate battle lines of verse 9.

decisions.choice: his people: his army
decisions.reason: "People" here means the fighting men the king of Maacah led.

decisions.choice: his people (Literal); his army (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "people" means in a list of hired forces.

decisions.choice: o seu povo (L), o seu exército (B, R); Medeba; trinta e dois mil
decisions.reason: "Povo" at Literal, "exército" at Balanced and Readable, as the English (m4). "Medeba" is the form of Numbers 21:30 and Joshua 13 in Portuguese. The count is written in words, as 2 Samuel 10 in Portuguese writes its round thousands.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמַ֖ע דָּוִ֑יד וַיִּשְׁלַח֙ אֶת־יוֹאָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־צָבָ֖א הַגִּבּוֹרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard David, and he sent Joab and all [the] army, the mighty men.

en.L: And David heard, and he sent Joab and all [the] army, the mighty men.
en.B: When David heard about this, he sent out Joab with the whole army of warriors.
en.R: When David heard about this, he sent out Joab with the whole army of fighting men.

es.L: Y lo oyó David, y envió a Joab y a todo el ejército, los valientes.
es.B: Cuando David se enteró, envió a Joab con todo el ejército de guerreros.
es.R: Cuando David se enteró, envió a Joab con todo el ejército de soldados.

fr.L: Et David [l’]apprit, et il envoya Joab et toute l’armée, les vaillants.
fr.B: Quand David l’apprit, il envoya Joab avec toute l’armée des guerriers.
fr.R: Quand David l’a appris, il a envoyé Joab avec toute l’armée des combattants.

sw.L: Daudi akasikia, akamtuma Yoabu na jeshi lote, mashujaa.
sw.B: Daudi aliposikia habari hiyo, alimtuma Yoabu pamoja na jeshi lote la mashujaa.
sw.R: Daudi aliposikia habari hiyo, alimtuma Yoabu pamoja na jeshi lote la wapiganaji.

vi.L: Đa-vít nghe [vậy], thì sai Giô-áp cùng toàn quân, là các dũng sĩ.
vi.B: Khi Đa-vít nghe tin này, ông sai Giô-áp ra trận cùng toàn quân gồm các chiến binh.
vi.R: Khi Đa-vít nghe tin này, ông sai Giô-áp ra trận cùng toàn thể đạo quân thiện chiến.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 [그것을] 듣고, 요압과 모든 군대, 곧 용사들을 보냈다.
ko.B: 다윗은 이 소식을 듣고 요압과 용사들로 이루어진 온 군대를 보냈다.
ko.R: 다윗은 이 소식을 듣고 요압에게 싸움 잘하는 군인들로 이루어진 온 군대를 주어 보냈다.

pt.L: E Davi ouviu, e enviou Joabe e todo o exército, os valentes.
pt.B: Quando Davi soube disso, enviou Joabe com todo o exército de guerreiros.
pt.R: Quando Davi soube disso, mandou Joabe com todo o exército de soldados valentes.

decisions.choice: all the army, the mighty men: the whole army, all of them warriors
alternatives: the whole army and the mighty men (David's elite band)
decisions.reason: The two phrases stand side by side with no "and", as in 2 Samuel 10:7, where "army" has the article; here it does not. They are read here as one group, the army described as fighting men. They may also name two groups, the army and David's band of elite warriors (11:10-47).

decisions.choice: Joab: commander of David's army
decisions.reason: Joab was the son of David's sister Zeruiah (2:16) and commanded the army (11:6; 18:15).

decisions.choice: warriors (Balanced); fighting men (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word means strong men proven in battle. Literal keeps the traditional "mighty men", as in 2 Samuel 10:7.

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 10:7
decisions.reason: The same words as 2 Samuel 10:7 (m1), and the Portuguese of 2 Samuel is kept at every level: "os valentes" (L), "guerreiros" (B), "soldados valentes" (R).

source.text: וַיֵּצְאוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וַיַּֽעַרְכ֥וּ מִלְחָמָ֖ה פֶּ֣תַח הָעִ֑יר וְהַמְּלָכִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֔אוּ לְבַדָּ֖ם בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came out [the] sons of Ammon and drew up battle [at the] entrance of the city, and the kings who had come [were] by themselves in the field.

en.L: And the sons of Ammon came out and drew up [for] battle at the entrance of the city, and the kings who had come [were] by themselves in the field.
en.B: The Ammonites marched out and formed their battle line at the city entrance, while the kings who had come took a separate position in the open country.
en.R: The Ammonites marched out and got ready for battle at the entrance to their city. The kings who had come to help them took their places away from them, out in the open country.

es.L: Y salieron los hijos de Amón y se pusieron en orden de batalla a la entrada de la ciudad, y los reyes que habían venido [estaban] aparte en el campo.
es.B: Los amonitas salieron y formaron su línea de batalla a la entrada de la ciudad, mientras que los reyes que habían venido tomaron posición aparte, en campo abierto.
es.R: Los amonitas salieron y se prepararon para la batalla a la entrada de su ciudad. Los reyes que habían venido a ayudarlos se colocaron lejos de ellos, en campo abierto.

fr.L: Et les fils d’Ammon sortirent et se rangèrent en bataille à l’entrée de la ville, et les rois qui étaient venus [étaient] à part dans la campagne.
fr.B: Les Ammonites sortirent et se rangèrent en ordre de bataille à l’entrée de la ville, tandis que les rois qui étaient venus prirent position à part, en rase campagne.
fr.R: Les Ammonites sont sortis et se sont préparés au combat devant l’entrée de leur ville. Les rois qui étaient venus les aider se sont placés plus loin, en pleine campagne.

sw.L: Wana wa Amoni wakatoka wakajipanga [kwa] vita kwenye mlango wa mji, na wafalme waliokuja [walikuwa] peke yao uwanjani.
sw.B: Waamoni walitoka wakajipanga kwa vita kwenye lango la mji, huku wafalme waliokuja wakijipanga peke yao mbugani.
sw.R: Waamoni walitoka wakajiandaa kwa vita kwenye lango la mji wao. Wafalme waliokuja kuwasaidia walijipanga mbali nao, kule mbugani.

vi.L: Con cháu Am-môn kéo ra và dàn trận tại lối vào thành, còn các vua đã đến thì ở riêng ngoài đồng.
vi.B: Người Am-môn kéo ra và dàn trận tại cổng thành, còn các vua đã đến thì đóng quân riêng ngoài đồng trống.
vi.R: Người Am-môn kéo ra và dàn trận tại cổng thành của họ. Các vua đã đến giúp họ thì đóng quân riêng ở ngoài đồng trống.

ko.L: 그리고 암몬 자손이 나와서 성문 입구에서 전열을 갖추었고, 온 왕들은 따로 들에 [있었다].
ko.B: 암몬 사람들은 나와서 성문 어귀에 전열을 갖추었고, 그들을 도우러 온 왕들은 따로 들판에 진을 쳤다.
ko.R: 암몬 사람들은 나와서 자기들 성문 앞에서 싸울 준비를 했다. 그들을 도우러 온 왕들은 그들과 떨어져서 넓은 들판에 자리를 잡았다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Amom saíram e se puseram em ordem de batalha à entrada da cidade, e os reis que tinham vindo [estavam] à parte, no campo.
pt.B: Os amonitas saíram e formaram a sua linha de batalha à entrada da cidade, enquanto os reis que tinham vindo tomaram posição à parte, em campo aberto.
pt.R: Os amonitas saíram e se prepararam para a batalha junto à entrada da sua cidade. Os reis que tinham vindo ajudá-los ficaram longe deles, em campo aberto.

decisions.choice: the entrance of the city and the kings who had come: differences from 2 Samuel 10:8
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:8 says "the entrance of the gate" and lists the allies again: the Arameans of Zobah and Rehob, and the men of Tob and Maacah. Chronicles says "the entrance of the city" and speaks only of "the kings who had come".

decisions.choice: by themselves in the field: as a separate force in the open country
decisions.reason: The hired forces did not stand with the Ammonites but took up a position of their own in open ground. That placed Joab's army between two enemy forces (verse 10).

decisions.choice: the city: most likely Rabbah, Ammon's capital
decisions.reason: The Ammonites stayed close to the walls of a city where they could retreat if beaten (verse 15). In 2 Samuel 10 and 11 this is Rabbah. Since Chronicles has just named Medeba (verse 7), the city could also be Medeba, but the text does not say so.

decisions.choice: the kings who had come to help them; their city
decisions.reason: Readable says why the kings had come and whose city it was, which the context makes clear.

decisions.choice: à entrada da cidade; os reis que tinham vindo
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:8 in Portuguese with Chronicles' changes (m1): "a cidade" for "a porta", and "os reis que tinham vindo" in place of the list of allies.

source.text: וַיַּ֣רְא יוֹאָ֗ב כִּֽי־הָיְתָ֧ה פְנֵי־הַמִּלְחָמָ֛ה אֵלָ֖יו פָּנִ֣ים וְאָח֑וֹר וַיִּבְחַ֗ר מִכָּל־בָּחוּר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיַּעֲרֹ֖ךְ לִקְרַ֥את אֲרָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw Joab that was [the] face of the battle against him front and rear, and he chose from every chosen [man] in Israel and drew up to meet Aram.

en.L: And Joab saw that the front of the battle was against him in front and behind, and he chose from every chosen [man] in Israel and drew [them] up to meet Aram.
en.B: Joab saw that the battle lines faced him both in front and behind. So he picked some of Israel's best troops and lined them up against the Arameans.
en.R: Joab saw that he would have to fight enemies in front of him and enemies behind him. So he chose the best of Israel's soldiers and put them in place to fight the Arameans.

es.L: Y vio Joab que el frente de la batalla estaba contra él por delante y por detrás, y escogió de entre todos los escogidos de Israel y [los] puso en orden contra Aram.
es.B: Joab vio que tenía líneas de batalla por delante y por detrás. Entonces escogió a algunas de las mejores tropas de Israel y las puso en formación contra los arameos.
es.R: Joab vio que tendría que luchar contra enemigos por delante y por detrás. Así que escogió a los mejores soldados de Israel y los colocó para luchar contra los arameos.

fr.L: Et Joab vit que le front de la bataille était contre lui par devant et par derrière, et il choisit parmi toute l’élite d’Israël et [la] rangea face à Aram.
fr.B: Joab vit que les lignes ennemies lui faisaient face à la fois devant et derrière. Il choisit donc une partie des meilleures troupes d’Israël et les rangea face aux Araméens.
fr.R: Joab a vu qu’il devrait combattre des ennemis devant lui et des ennemis derrière lui. Alors il a choisi les meilleurs soldats d’Israël et il les a placés pour combattre les Araméens.

sw.L: Yoabu akaona kwamba uso wa vita ulikuwa juu yake mbele na nyuma, akachagua katika wateule wote wa Israeli akawapanga kukabiliana na Aramu.
sw.B: Yoabu aliona kwamba safu za vita zinamkabili mbele na nyuma. Basi akachagua baadhi ya askari bora wa Israeli, akawapanga kukabiliana na Waaramu.
sw.R: Yoabu aliona kwamba atalazimika kupigana na adui walio mbele yake na adui walio nyuma yake. Basi akachagua askari bora wa Israeli, akawaweka tayari kupigana na Waaramu.

vi.L: Giô-áp thấy mặt trận chống lại mình ở phía trước và phía sau, thì chọn trong tất cả những người tinh nhuệ của Y-sơ-ra-ên, và dàn [họ] ra đối đầu với A-ram.
vi.B: Giô-áp thấy mình bị kẹp giữa hai mặt trận, phía trước và phía sau. Vì vậy ông chọn một số quân tinh nhuệ nhất của Y-sơ-ra-ên và dàn trận đối đầu với người A-ram.
vi.R: Giô-áp thấy mình phải đánh quân thù ở phía trước và quân thù ở phía sau. Vì vậy ông chọn những người lính giỏi nhất của Y-sơ-ra-ên và cho họ dàn trận để đánh người A-ram.

ko.L: 그리고 요압이 싸움의 앞쪽이 앞과 뒤에서 자기를 향해 있는 것을 보고, 이스라엘의 모든 뽑힌 [사람] 가운데서 뽑아 아람과 맞서 전열을 갖추었다.
ko.B: 요압은 앞뒤로 적의 전열이 자기를 향해 있는 것을 보았다. 그래서 그는 이스라엘의 정예병 가운데서 군사를 뽑아 아람 사람들과 맞서도록 전열을 갖추었다.
ko.R: 요압은 앞쪽과 뒤쪽 양쪽에서 적과 싸워야 한다는 것을 알았다. 그래서 그는 이스라엘 군인 가운데 가장 뛰어난 사람들을 뽑아 아람 사람들과 싸우도록 배치했다.

pt.L: E Joabe viu que a frente da batalha estava contra ele, pela frente e por trás, e escolheu dentre todo escolhido em Israel e [os] dispôs em ordem contra Arã.
pt.B: Joabe viu que as linhas de batalha estavam contra ele, pela frente e pela retaguarda. Então escolheu alguns dos melhores soldados de Israel e os pôs em posição contra os arameus.
pt.R: Joabe viu que teria de lutar contra inimigos na frente e inimigos atrás. Por isso escolheu os melhores soldados de Israel e os colocou em posição para lutar contra os arameus.

decisions.choice: the face of the battle was against him front and rear: he was facing enemy lines on two sides
decisions.reason: "The face of the battle" is the front line of an army. Joab found the Ammonites before the city on one side and the hired kings in the open country on the other (verse 9).

decisions.choice: every chosen man in Israel: compare 2 Samuel 10:9
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "from every chosen man in Israel". In 2 Samuel 10:9 the written consonants read "from all the chosen men in Israel" and the traditional reading in the margin has "of Israel". Samuel also says "from in front and from behind" where Chronicles has "front and rear". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: he chose from every chosen man: picked troops from the best
decisions.reason: The verb "chose" and the noun "chosen man" come from the same root. Joab took the best of Israel's soldiers to face the stronger enemy himself.

decisions.choice: Aram (Literal); the Arameans (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The land's name stands for its army. Balanced and Readable name the people, as in the rest of the chapter.

decisions.choice: dentre todo escolhido em Israel
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:9 in Portuguese at every level; Literal follows Chronicles' "every chosen [man] in Israel" (m2) where 2 Samuel has "todos os escolhidos de Israel".

source.text: וְאֵת֙ יֶ֣תֶר הָעָ֔ם נָתַ֕ן בְּיַ֖ד אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֑יו וַיַּ֣עַרְכ֔וּ לִקְרַ֖את בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of the people he gave into [the] hand of Abishai his brother, and they drew up to meet [the] sons of Ammon.

en.L: And the rest of the people he gave into [the] hand of Abishai his brother, and they drew up to meet the sons of Ammon.
en.B: He put the rest of the troops under the command of his brother Abishai, and they lined up against the Ammonites.
en.R: He put his brother Abishai in charge of the rest of the army. They lined up to face the Ammonites.

es.L: Y el resto del pueblo lo entregó en mano de Abisai su hermano, y se pusieron en orden contra los hijos de Amón.
es.B: Puso el resto de las tropas al mando de su hermano Abisai, y se pusieron en formación contra los amonitas.
es.R: Puso a su hermano Abisai al mando del resto del ejército. Se colocaron frente a los amonitas.

fr.L: Et le reste du peuple, il le donna en la main d’Abishaï son frère, et ils se rangèrent face aux fils d’Ammon.
fr.B: Il confia le reste des troupes au commandement de son frère Abishaï, et ils se rangèrent face aux Ammonites.
fr.R: Il a mis son frère Abishaï à la tête du reste de l’armée. Ils se sont placés face aux Ammonites.

sw.L: Na watu waliobaki akawatia mkononi mwa Abishai ndugu yake, nao wakajipanga kukabiliana na wana wa Amoni.
sw.B: Askari waliobaki aliwaweka chini ya amri ya ndugu yake Abishai, nao wakajipanga kukabiliana na Waamoni.
sw.R: Akamweka ndugu yake Abishai kuwa mkuu wa jeshi lililobaki. Nao wakajipanga kukabiliana na Waamoni.

vi.L: Phần dân còn lại ông giao vào tay A-bi-sai em mình, và họ dàn trận đối đầu với con cháu Am-môn.
vi.B: Ông giao số quân còn lại cho A-bi-sai em mình chỉ huy, và họ dàn trận đối đầu với người Am-môn.
vi.R: Ông giao cho A-bi-sai, em mình, chỉ huy phần quân còn lại. Rồi họ dàn trận đối mặt với người Am-môn.

ko.L: 그리고 남은 백성은 그의 동생 아비새의 손에 맡겼고, 그들이 암몬 자손과 맞서 전열을 갖추었다.
ko.B: 그리고 나머지 군대는 자기 동생 아비새에게 맡겨, 암몬 사람들과 맞서도록 전열을 갖추게 했다.
ko.R: 요압은 자기 동생 아비새에게 나머지 군대를 맡겼다. 그리고 그들은 암몬 사람들과 맞서도록 줄지어 섰다.

pt.L: E o resto do povo ele entregou na mão de Abisai, seu irmão, e se dispuseram em ordem contra os filhos de Amom.
pt.B: Ele pôs o restante das tropas sob o comando do seu irmão Abisai, e elas se puseram em ordem contra os amonitas.
pt.R: Ele colocou o seu irmão Abisai no comando do resto do exército. Eles se puseram em posição para enfrentar os amonitas.

decisions.choice: gave into the hand of Abishai: put under Abishai's command
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for authority and control. Abishai was Joab's brother, another son of Zeruiah (2:16).

decisions.choice: they drew up: 2 Samuel 10:10 has "he drew up"
decisions.reason: In Samuel the verb is singular and may mean Joab or Abishai. Chronicles has the plural: Abishai's troops took up their positions facing the Ammonites.

decisions.choice: the people (Literal); the troops (Balanced); the army (Readable)
decisions.reason: The word "people" here means the fighting men in the field, as in 2 Samuel 10:10.

decisions.choice: se dispuseram (plural)
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:10 in Portuguese, with the verb in the plural, as Chronicles has it (m2): the troops took their places.

source.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר אִם־תֶּחֱזַ֤ק מִמֶּ֨נִּי֙ אֲרָ֔ם וְהָיִ֥יתָ לִּ֖י לִתְשׁוּעָ֑הסוְאִם־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֛וֹן יֶֽחֶזְק֥וּ מִמְּךָ֖ וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said, If is too strong Aram for me, then you will be for me for help; and if [the] sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

en.L: And he said, "If Aram is too strong for me, then you shall be a help to me; and if the sons of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.
en.B: Joab said, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, you must come to my rescue. But if the Ammonites are too strong for you, I will rescue you.
en.R: Joab told Abishai, "If the Arameans are too strong for me, come and help me. If the Ammonites are too strong for you, I will help you.

es.L: Y dijo: «Si Aram es más fuerte que yo, tú me serás de ayuda; y si los hijos de Amón son más fuertes que tú, yo te ayudaré.
es.B: Joab dijo: «Si los arameos son demasiado fuertes para mí, tú vendrás a rescatarme. Pero si los amonitas son demasiado fuertes para ti, yo te rescataré.
es.R: Joab le dijo a Abisai: «Si los arameos son demasiado fuertes para mí, ven a ayudarme. Si los amonitas son demasiado fuertes para ti, yo te ayudaré.

fr.L: Et il dit : « Si Aram est plus fort que moi, tu me viendras en aide ; et si les fils d’Ammon sont plus forts que toi, je te secourrai.
fr.B: Joab dit : « Si les Araméens sont plus forts que moi, tu viendras à mon secours. Mais si les Ammonites sont plus forts que toi, je te secourrai.
fr.R: Joab a dit à Abishaï : « Si les Araméens sont trop forts pour moi, viens m’aider. Si les Ammonites sont trop forts pour toi, je t’aiderai.

sw.L: Akasema, "Ikiwa Aramu watanizidi nguvu, basi utakuwa msaada kwangu; na ikiwa wana wa Amoni watakuzidi nguvu, basi nitakusaidia.
sw.B: Yoabu akasema, "Ikiwa Waaramu watanizidi nguvu, lazima uje kuniokoa. Lakini ikiwa Waamoni watakuzidi nguvu, nitakuokoa.
sw.R: Yoabu akamwambia Abishai, "Ikiwa Waaramu watanizidi nguvu, njoo unisaidie. Ikiwa Waamoni watakuzidi nguvu, nitakusaidia.

vi.L: Ông nói: "Nếu A-ram mạnh hơn anh, thì em sẽ là sự giúp đỡ cho anh; còn nếu con cháu Am-môn mạnh hơn em, thì anh sẽ giúp em.
vi.B: Giô-áp nói: "Nếu quân A-ram mạnh hơn anh, em phải đến cứu anh. Còn nếu quân Am-môn mạnh hơn em, anh sẽ cứu em.
vi.R: Giô-áp bảo A-bi-sai: "Nếu quân A-ram mạnh hơn anh, em hãy đến giúp anh. Nếu quân Am-môn mạnh hơn em, anh sẽ giúp em.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 말했다. "만일 아람이 나보다 강하면 네가 나에게 도움이 되어라. 그리고 만일 암몬 자손이 너보다 강하면 내가 너를 돕겠다.
ko.B: 요압이 말했다. "아람 사람들이 나보다 강하면 네가 와서 나를 구해 다오. 그러나 암몬 사람들이 너보다 강하면 내가 너를 구해 주겠다.
ko.R: 요압이 아비새에게 말했다. "아람 사람들이 나보다 강하면 와서 나를 도와라. 암몬 사람들이 너보다 강하면 내가 너를 돕겠다.

pt.L: E ele disse: "Se Arã for forte demais para mim, então você me servirá de socorro; e, se os filhos de Amom forem fortes demais para você, então eu o socorrerei.
pt.B: Joabe disse: "Se os arameus forem fortes demais para mim, você virá me socorrer. Mas, se os amonitas forem fortes demais para você, eu o socorrerei.
pt.R: Joabe disse a Abisai: "Se os arameus forem fortes demais para mim, venha me ajudar. Se os amonitas forem fortes demais para você, eu vou ajudá-lo.

decisions.choice: help, I will help you: rescue in battle
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb both come from the root that means to save or deliver. Here they mean coming to the aid of a fellow commander who is being overpowered, not salvation in a spiritual sense.

decisions.choice: too strong for me: stronger than the force I have
decisions.reason: The verb means "be strong"; with "for me" it means to overpower someone. Each brother promises to come to the other's side if his part of the battle goes badly.

decisions.choice: I will help you: 2 Samuel 10:11 has "I will come to help you"
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the verb "help" alone, without "come". The promise is the same.

decisions.choice: Joab said (Balanced); Joab told Abishai (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "he said". Balanced names the speaker, and Readable also names the one he spoke to, as in 2 Samuel 10:11.

decisions.choice: help (Literal, Readable); rescue (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "rescue" to keep the strength of the word; Literal and Readable say "help". Since the word here means aid in battle, "save" would mislead.

decisions.choice: Joab says "anh" for himself and "em" to Abishai
decisions.reason: As the Vietnamese 2 Samuel 10:11, Joab is the older brother.

decisions.choice: Joab speaks to his younger brother Abishai in the plain style (해라체)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 10:11 in Korean and the Genesis note: an older brother speaks 해라체 to a younger one.

decisions.choice: eu o socorrerei (L, B)
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:11 in Portuguese ("socorro", "socorrer"; "você" between the brothers), with "eu o socorrerei" for "eu irei socorrê-lo", since Chronicles has the verb without "come" (m3). Readable's "eu vou ajudá-lo" already says no more than that.

source.text: חֲזַ֤ק וְנִֽתְחַזְּקָה֙ בְּעַד־עַמֵּ֔נוּ וּבְעַ֖ד עָרֵ֣י אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽיהוָ֔ה הַטּ֥וֹב בְּעֵינָ֖יו יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: Be strong, and let us show ourselves strong for our people and for [the] cities of our God; and Yahweh the good in his eyes will do.

en.L: Be strong, and let us show ourselves strong for our people and for the cities of our God; and may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} do what is good in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} eyes."
en.B: Be strong! Let us show courage for the sake of our people and the cities of our God. And may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} do what seems good to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}."
en.R: Be brave! Let us fight hard to protect our people and the cities of our God. And may {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} do whatever {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} thinks is best."

es.L: Esfuérzate, y esforcémonos por nuestro pueblo y por las ciudades de nuestro Dios; y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga lo que es bueno a {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} ojos».
es.B: ¡Sé fuerte! Mostremos valor por nuestro pueblo y por las ciudades de nuestro Dios. Y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga lo que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} parezca bien».
es.R: ¡Sé valiente! Luchemos con fuerza para proteger a nuestro pueblo y las ciudades de nuestro Dios. Y que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} haga lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} crea que es mejor».

fr.L: Sois fort, et montrons-nous forts pour notre peuple et pour les villes de notre Dieu ; et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fasse ce qui est bon à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} yeux. »
fr.B: Sois fort ! Montrons du courage pour notre peuple et pour les villes de notre Dieu. Et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fasse ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} semble bon. »
fr.R: Sois courageux ! Battons-nous de toutes nos forces pour protéger notre peuple et les villes de notre Dieu. Et que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fasse ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} juge le meilleur. »

sw.L: Uwe hodari, na tujionyeshe hodari kwa ajili ya watu wetu na kwa ajili ya miji ya Mungu wetu; na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na afanye lililo jema machoni {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}."
sw.B: Uwe hodari! Tuonyeshe ujasiri kwa ajili ya watu wetu na miji ya Mungu wetu. Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na afanye lile analoona kuwa jema."
sw.R: Uwe jasiri! Tupigane kwa nguvu zote kuwalinda watu wetu na miji ya Mungu wetu. Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na afanye lolote analoona kuwa bora."

vi.L: Hãy mạnh mẽ, và chúng ta hãy tỏ ra mạnh mẽ vì dân ta và vì các thành của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta; nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm điều tốt trong mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Hãy mạnh mẽ lên! Chúng ta hãy can đảm vì dân ta và vì các thành của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho là tốt."
vi.R: Hãy can đảm lên! Chúng ta hãy chiến đấu hết sức để bảo vệ dân ta và các thành của Đức Chúa Trời chúng ta. Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm điều gì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thấy là tốt nhất."

ko.L: 강하여라. 우리 백성과 우리 하나님의 성읍들을 위하여 우리가 힘을 내자. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분의 눈에 좋은 대로 행하시기를 [바란다]."
ko.B: 힘을 내라! 우리 백성과 우리 하나님의 성읍들을 위해 용감하게 싸우자. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그분 보시기에 좋은 대로 하실 것이다."
ko.R: 용감해라! 우리 백성과 우리 하나님의 성읍들을 지키려고 힘껏 싸우자. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 가장 좋다고 여기시는 대로 하실 것이다."

pt.L: Seja forte, e mostremo-nos fortes pelo nosso povo e pelas cidades do nosso Deus; e que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça o que [é] bom aos {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} olhos."
pt.B: Seja forte! Sejamos corajosos pelo nosso povo e pelas cidades do nosso Deus. E que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça o que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} parecer bom."
pt.R: Seja valente! Vamos lutar com todas as forças para proteger o nosso povo e as cidades do nosso Deus. E que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} faça o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} achar melhor."

decisions.choice: the same words as 2 Samuel 10:12
decisions.reason: Joab's call is word for word as in Samuel, except that the last clause puts "what is good in his eyes" before the verb "do". The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: be strong, and let us show ourselves strong: an order and a shared call
decisions.reason: Joab first tells Abishai to be strong, then joins himself to the call: "let us". The second verb means to take courage and act boldly.

decisions.choice: the cities of our God: Israel's towns as belonging to God
decisions.reason: The towns of Israel stood in the land God had given his people. Defending them was defending what was his.

decisions.choice: may Yahweh do what is good in his eyes: a statement of trust that leaves the outcome to God
alternatives: and Yahweh will do what is good in his eyes
decisions.reason: The verb can be read as a wish ("may Yahweh do") or as a statement ("Yahweh will do"). Either way Joab commits the result of the battle to Yahweh after doing all he can (1 Samuel 3:18; 2 Samuel 15:26).

decisions.choice: let us show courage (Balanced); let us fight hard (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to show strength. Balanced says it is courage; Readable, in a battle speech, says what that strength is for. The wording follows 2 Samuel 10:12.

decisions.choice: what seems good to him (Balanced); whatever he thinks is best (Readable)
decisions.reason: "In his eyes" means "in his judgment". Literal keeps the picture.

decisions.choice: as 2 Samuel 10:12
decisions.reason: Joab's words are those of 2 Samuel 10:12 (m1), and so is the Portuguese at every level; the different order of the last clause in Hebrew does not change it.

source.text: וַיִּגַּ֨שׁ יוֹאָ֜ב וְהָעָ֧ם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּ֛וֹ לִפְנֵ֥י אֲרָ֖ם לַמִּלְחָמָ֑ה וַיָּנ֖וּסוּ מִפָּנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And drew near Joab and the people who [were] with him before Aram for the battle, and they fled from before him.

en.L: And Joab and the people who [were] with him drew near before Aram for battle, and they fled before him.
en.B: Then Joab and the troops with him advanced to fight the Arameans, and the Arameans fled from him.
en.R: Then Joab and his soldiers moved forward to attack the Arameans, and the Arameans ran away from them.

es.L: Y se acercó Joab y el pueblo que [estaba] con él delante de Aram para la batalla, y huyeron delante de él.
es.B: Entonces Joab y las tropas que lo acompañaban avanzaron para luchar contra los arameos, y los arameos huyeron delante de él.
es.R: Entonces Joab y sus soldados avanzaron para atacar a los arameos, y los arameos huyeron de ellos.

fr.L: Et Joab et le peuple qui [était] avec lui s’avancèrent devant Aram pour le combat, et ils s’enfuirent devant lui.
fr.B: Puis Joab et les troupes qui l’accompagnaient s’avancèrent pour attaquer les Araméens, et les Araméens s’enfuirent devant lui.
fr.R: Ensuite Joab et ses soldats se sont avancés pour attaquer les Araméens, et les Araméens se sont enfuis devant eux.

sw.L: Yoabu na watu waliokuwa pamoja naye wakakaribia mbele ya Aramu kwa vita, nao wakakimbia mbele yake.
sw.B: Kisha Yoabu na askari waliokuwa pamoja naye wakasonga mbele kupigana na Waaramu, na Waaramu wakamkimbia.
sw.R: Kisha Yoabu na askari wake wakasonga mbele kuwashambulia Waaramu, na Waaramu wakawakimbia.

vi.L: Giô-áp và dân ở với ông tiến đến trước A-ram để giao chiến, và chúng chạy trốn trước mặt ông.
vi.B: Rồi Giô-áp và quân ở với ông tiến lên đánh người A-ram, và quân A-ram bỏ chạy trước mặt ông.
vi.R: Rồi Giô-áp và binh lính của ông tiến lên tấn công người A-ram, và quân A-ram bỏ chạy.

ko.L: 그리고 요압과 그와 함께 [있는] 백성이 아람과 싸우려고 다가가자, 그들이 그 앞에서 도망쳤다.
ko.B: 요압과 그와 함께 있던 군대가 아람 사람들과 싸우려고 다가가자, 아람 사람들이 그 앞에서 도망쳤다.
ko.R: 요압과 그의 군인들이 아람 사람들을 공격하려고 나아가자, 아람 사람들은 그들 앞에서 달아났다.

pt.L: E Joabe e o povo que [estava] com ele se aproximaram diante de Arã para a batalha, e eles fugiram diante dele.
pt.B: Então Joabe e as tropas que estavam com ele avançaram para lutar contra os arameus, e os arameus fugiram diante dele.
pt.R: Então Joabe e os seus soldados avançaram para atacar os arameus, e os arameus fugiram deles.

decisions.choice: they fled before him: the Arameans ran from Joab
decisions.reason: "They" are the Arameans, and "him" is Joab. The hired army gave way as soon as Joab's picked troops attacked.

decisions.choice: before Aram: 2 Samuel 10:13 has "against Aram"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says Joab drew near "before" the Arameans for battle, where Samuel says he drew near to fight "against" them. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: the Arameans fled
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the ones who fled, which the Hebrew leaves to the context.

decisions.choice: the people (Literal); the troops (Balanced); his soldiers (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, "people" means the fighting men.

decisions.choice: diante de Arã (L)
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 10:13 in Portuguese; Literal says "diante de Arã" for Chronicles' "before Aram" where Samuel has "contra Arã" (m2).

source.text: וּבְנֵ֨י עַמּ֤וֹן רָאוּ֙ כִּי־נָ֣ס אֲרָ֔ם וַיָּנ֣וּסוּ גַם־הֵ֗ם מִפְּנֵי֙ אַבְשַׁ֣י אָחִ֔יו וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ הָעִ֑ירָה וַיָּבֹ֥א יוֹאָ֖ב יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Ammon saw that had fled Aram, and fled also they from before Abishai his brother and went into the city; and came Joab [to] Jerusalem.

en.L: And the sons of Ammon saw that Aram had fled, and they also fled before Abishai his brother and went into the city. And Joab came [to] Jerusalem.
en.B: When the Ammonites saw the Arameans flee, they also fled from Joab's brother Abishai and withdrew into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
en.R: When the Ammonites saw that the Arameans had run away, they also ran away from Abishai, Joab's brother, and went back into their city. So Joab went home to Jerusalem.

es.L: Y los hijos de Amón vieron que Aram había huido, y huyeron también ellos delante de Abisai su hermano y entraron en la ciudad. Y Joab llegó [a] Jerusalén.
es.B: Cuando los amonitas vieron que los arameos huían, ellos también huyeron de Abisai, el hermano de Joab, y se retiraron a la ciudad. Entonces Joab regresó a Jerusalén.
es.R: Cuando los amonitas vieron que los arameos habían huido, ellos también huyeron de Abisai, el hermano de Joab, y se metieron otra vez en su ciudad. Así que Joab regresó a Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et les fils d’Ammon virent qu’Aram s’était enfui, et ils s’enfuirent eux aussi devant Abishaï son frère et entrèrent dans la ville. Et Joab arriva [à] Jérusalem.
fr.B: Quand les Ammonites virent que les Araméens s’étaient enfuis, ils s’enfuirent eux aussi devant Abishaï, le frère de Joab, et se retirèrent dans la ville. Alors Joab revint à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Quand les Ammonites ont vu que les Araméens s’étaient enfuis, ils se sont enfuis eux aussi devant Abishaï, le frère de Joab, et ils sont rentrés dans leur ville. Alors Joab est rentré à Jérusalem.

sw.L: Wana wa Amoni walipoona kwamba Aramu wamekimbia, wao nao wakakimbia mbele ya Abishai ndugu yake wakaingia mjini. Naye Yoabu akafika [mpaka] Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Waamoni walipoona Waaramu wakikimbia, wao pia wakamkimbia Abishai ndugu yake Yoabu, wakaingia mjini. Kisha Yoabu akarudi Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Waamoni walipoona kwamba Waaramu wamekimbia, wao nao wakamkimbia Abishai, ndugu yake Yoabu, wakarudi ndani ya mji wao. Basi Yoabu akarudi nyumbani Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Con cháu Am-môn thấy A-ram đã chạy trốn, thì họ cũng chạy trốn trước mặt A-bi-sai em ông và vào thành. Giô-áp về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Khi người Am-môn thấy quân A-ram bỏ chạy, họ cũng bỏ chạy trước mặt A-bi-sai, em Giô-áp, và rút vào trong thành. Bấy giờ Giô-áp về Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Khi người Am-môn thấy quân A-ram đã bỏ chạy, họ cũng chạy trốn A-bi-sai, em Giô-áp, và rút vào trong thành của họ. Vậy Giô-áp trở về Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 암몬 자손이 아람이 도망친 것을 보고, 그들도 그의 동생 아비새 앞에서 도망쳐 성으로 들어갔다. 그리고 요압이 예루살렘으로 왔다.
ko.B: 암몬 사람들은 아람 사람들이 도망치는 것을 보고, 그들도 요압의 동생 아비새 앞에서 도망쳐 성 안으로 들어갔다. 그러자 요압은 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다.
ko.R: 암몬 사람들은 아람 사람들이 달아나는 것을 보고, 자기들도 요압의 동생 아비새 앞에서 달아나 성 안으로 들어갔다. 그래서 요압은 예루살렘으로 돌아왔다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Amom viram que Arã tinha fugido, e também eles fugiram diante de Abisai, seu irmão, e entraram na cidade. E Joabe foi [a] Jerusalém.
pt.B: Quando os amonitas viram que os arameus tinham fugido, também fugiram de Abisai, irmão de Joabe, e se recolheram na cidade. Então Joabe voltou para Jerusalém.
